opinion.summary: Patch fixes the truncation symptom (missing final append) so the two public tests pass, but it deletes the documented contract instead of conforming to it and leaves the core splitting logic unchanged. The remaining rfind/loop still infinite-loops on leading spaces and mishandles edge cases, so this is not mergeable as a correct contract fix.

hypotheses.note: Two truncated AssertionErrors show a test failure but the ellipsis hides actual vs expected values and the contract text; cannot verify from cited evidence alone that the failure is the documented-contract disagreement vs another bug.

risks: Deletes the Wrap Text docstring/contract instead of fixing implementation to meet it, hiding the specification that defines correctness
Infinite loop survives: when remaining text starts with space and len>cols, rfind returns 0, end==0, line='' and text unchanged, loop never terminates

Empty and exact-length edge cases not handled cleanly: wrap('', cols) now returns [''] and multiple-space inputs can produce empty-string lines, violating 'concatenation returns original' and 'no word broken unless necessary' invariant
No fix to space-preservation/word-boundary logic; same flawed rfind(0, cols+1) splitting remains elsewhere in file
